title: Quadratic functions, vertex form (MathPSS / Dennis Weber)
content_or_local_path: Change the parameters to investigate their effect on the function graph. Compare g(x) to f(x). Point A is the vertex of f(x) and B is the vertex of g(x).
context: Public GeoGebra material. Sliders p, q, a with f(x) = a(x − p)^2 + q. Signed-out Classic URL loaded; Sign in remained available on the material page.
fallback: Use the locally bundled JSXGraph vertex-form sliders in this lesson. Do not require GeoGebra.
